TITLE: Trello
UNAVAILABLE: The Trello integration is not loaded on this server (TRELLO_ENABLED is off).
NOT_CONFIGURED: The Trello application is not configured on this server (TRELLO_API_KEY and the return page). Nobody can connect until it is.

CONNECT.TITLE: Connect your Trello account
CONNECT.TEXT: You will allow this platform in Trello and come back here. Then map Trello boards to projects, import their cards as tasks, and keep them in sync.

REASONS.token_refused: Trello refused the token (it may have been revoked). Connect again.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Trello settings
SETTINGS.WEBHOOKS_ON: On: Trello sends changes as they happen.
SETTINGS.WEBHOOKS_OFF: Off: this server has no public address for Trello or no application secret (TRELLO_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL, TRELLO_API_SECRET); use the imports.
SETTINGS.DISCONNECT_CONFIRM: Disconnect Trello from this organization? The mappings go; the imported tasks stay.

MAPPINGS.TITLE: Boards and projects
MAPPINGS.INTRO: Each Trello board maps to one project. Inbound brings the board's cards in as tasks; outbound sends the project's tasks to Trello (one outbound mapping per project). An archived or done card is always the completed status; a list can name the status its cards get.
MAPPINGS.LIST_MAP_HINT: The task status name a card gets in each list of the board. Leave a list blank to use its name when it is a status, else open.
MAPPINGS.WEBHOOK_REQUESTED: The webhook is being registered; the list refreshes in a moment.
MAPPINGS.REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove this mapping? The imported tasks stay.
MAPPINGS.IMPORT_STARTED: The import started; see the runs below.
MAPPINGS.NO_BOARDS: Every board the member can see is mapped, or there is none.

RUNS.TITLE: Runs
RUNS.SHOW_CONFLICTS: List the conflicts this run found

CONFLICTS.TITLE: Sync conflicts
CONFLICTS.INTRO: A field changed both in Trello and on the platform since they last agreed. Trello's value was applied to the task, and the task's value is kept here: keep Trello's value, or restore the task's (a mapping that sends changes out sends it to the card too).
CONFLICTS.KEPT_EXTERNAL: Resolved: the task keeps the value it has now.
CONFLICTS.KEPT_PLATFORM: The task's value was written back.

ERRORS.STALE: The task changed since the conflict was found, so its value was not written back. Keep Trello's value, or edit the task.
ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: This conflict was resolved already; the list was read again.
